name: Filament Swatch Card
description: A swatch card for cataloguing spools: colour name, brand, material and print temperature debossed or inlaid into the face, a row of stepped windows from 0.2 mm up in 0.2 mm increments, each labelled with its thickness, and an optional hole for a swatch ring. Landscape or portrait. Debossed prints in one filament; inlaid adds the lettering on extruder 2.
source: inspired by Printables Filament swatch customizer
